reviews.title: Card works totally fine, cable issue.
reviews.comment: Received both the card wrapped and covered beautifully. Card is in complete working order, no signs of abuse or crypto mining, no damage at all. The issue is the cable it came with, do not get me wrong it completely works, but it was totally abused beforehand, some of the bits popped out of the little case. Besides that, good for the money, just be careful and look over what you get and decide if you want to send it back.
reviews.author: John Lawyer
